newsitem.title: USA: Sixteen students, driver hurt in school bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen students, driver hurt in school bus crash.

text.p: A bus driver and 16 students were injured, four seriously, when a school bus overturned in a ditch on a rural road near Angleton, Texas south of Houston, on Monday emergency officials said.
The bus flipped on its side into a culvert carrying a bayou under the road, pinning one student in the wreckage and trapping the others inside until emergency crews arrived, the officials said.

"Everybody was still inside the bus. We got all the walking wounded out and then we had to work on the people who were seriously injured to get them to be moved out," Mike Jones, assistant Angleton fire chief, told reporters.

Four students were flown by Life Flight helicopter to the University of Texas Medical Branch hospital in Galveston, where two were listed in serious condition and two were in critical condition, a hospital spokeswoman said.
Police were searching for the driver of a black pick-up truck that apparently forced the bus off the road, a police spokeswoman said.

The bus was carrying elementary and middle school students of the Angleton Independent School District in Brazoria County, a rural area on the Texas Gulf coast about 25 miles (40 km) south of Houston.
